introduction: Crafting Apps with Passion and Precision.
As a Software Developer, I specialize in creating intuitive apps for Android and iOS. Check out my portfolio or reach out to discuss your next project!
aboutMe: Experienced Software Engineer with 3+ years in mobile app development. Skilled in delivering enterprise-grade solutions and utilizing the latest technologies to enhance user experiences. Passionate about staying current with industry trends and continuously improving skills. Enjoys gaming & solo travel :)

description: Delivered a native SDK for digital fan experiences, enhancing fan interaction for a leading sports council.
Developed and maintained Flutter-based fan engagement apps, improving UI appeal and user satisfaction.
Optimized code architecture with GetX, Provider, and BLoC for scalability and future-proofing.
Created a communication module between Flutter and native code to enhance app performance.
Improved app performance with profiling and optimization for faster load times and smoother animations.
Oversaw mobile app development from concept to release, ensuring complete project delivery.
Applied MVVM architecture to enhance code maintainability and streamline development.
Integrated Stripe to improve in-app payment capabilities.
Created role-based screen stacks to enhance accessibility.
Implemented password less authentication with Magic Link for better security and user convenience.
